title: Heater control with over-temperature cutout
nl_spec: A heater is energized when there is a heat demand (HeatRequest) and the system is enabled (Enable). An over-temperature sensor (OverTemp = TRUE when too hot) must unconditionally cut the heater off as a safety override, regardless of demand or enable. The heater is not latching: it follows demand each scan when safe. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named heater_ctrl with inputs HeatRequest, Enable, OverTemp and output Heater.

safety_properties.nl: On over-temperature, the heater is always off.
The heater is only on when the system is enabled.
The heater is only on when there is a heat demand.

scenarios.description: Heat on demand, cut on over-temp

notes: Non-latching combinational control with a hard safety override; contrast with the latching tasks E01/E04/E05.
